EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

X10 Pro Omni vs. X9 Pro
eufy lists some mop cloths for both models. That shared accessory does not establish fit for filters, roller brushes, side brushes, dock parts, or complete kits; check each item's model list.
Robot filter vs. station dust bag
The washable filter sits in the robot's dust box. The disposable 2.5 L bag sits inside the Omni Station. They are different parts with different fit and care instructions.
Official X10 parts kit
The eufy kit lists one roller, one brush guard, two side brushes, one washable filter, and two mop cloths. It does not list station dust bags.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

eufy X10 Pro Omni maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

eufy X10 Pro Omni cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Dust boxWeeklyNo interval listed
Mopping padsWashed by the station after useEvery 3–6 months

Omni Station dust bagDisposableAbout 30–60 days; varies by household

Rinse the original washable filter with water only and let it air-dry completely (about 24 hours) before reinstalling. Never reinstall it damp. The linked third-party filter listing calls its filters disposable, so follow that product's own care instructions.

Before you order

Will eufy X9 Pro replacement parts fit the X10 Pro Omni?

Do not assume so. eufy lists some mop cloths for both models, but the roller, filter, station parts, and complete kits need their own X10 Pro Omni compatibility check.

Is the X10 Pro Omni filter washable?

The original eufy X10 filter is washable: clean it weekly with water and let it dry completely before reuse. The third-party filter listing above describes its six filters as disposable, so do not treat that listing as the original washable filter.

Does the robot use the same filter and dust bag?

No. The robot's dust-box filter is washable. The station's 2.5 L collection bag is disposable and is sold separately.

Does the official X10 parts kit include station dust bags?

The checked eufy kit lists a roller, brush guard, two side brushes, one washable filter, and two mop cloths. It does not list the station dust bag.
